frame_wall_definition: FrameExecutionStart.started_at to post-Host observation.now; App plus native Host/submit wall including waits, not CPU execution/GPU execution/scanout
gpu_completion_definition: original App frame start to queue-completion callback observation, not GPU execution/scanout

paused_cadence.cpu_claim: raw quantized process counters only; no stable CPU or power reduction claim
paused_cadence.scope: sum of App-frame deltas across all paired 300 ms intervals after excluded settles, both recipes; actual cooperative wall spans remain in each interval

first_presentation.scope: first original actual presentation; exact App/render/window/device transaction, App frame start through post-Host observation including waits; not GPU execution or scanout; separate from running warmup and measured frames

controls.scope: after both idle intervals; original Wait maintenance, one original StepFixedTick then full paused maintenance, followed by Poll Resume/Pause; excluded from running samples and cadence totals

step_and_full_maintenance.step_poll_scope: one native poll may complete the automatic full frame requested after exact Step; explicit full paused maintenance is still requested afterward

paused_cadence.order_definition: Poll/Wait on odd numbered runs, Wait/Poll on even numbered runs, independently of plain/witness order

poll.presentation_definition: unique original successful receipts validated against current App/render/device transaction; not inferred from canonical state, App frames, poll calls, or scanout

process_cost.limitation: quantized Windows process counters; 15.625 ms increments were observed in the prior report; no stable CPU reduction claim or GPU execution/power measurement
process_cost.scope: whole-process counters around idle polling, including observer/caller/background/driver CPU and counter sampling overhead; excludes policy settling, canonical captures and subsequent controls; wall_ns covers the polling loop, not the counter calls

settle.scope: cooperative original polling after policy selection, excluded from idle and CPU samples; not a guarantee that all future native demand is absent

wait.presentation_definition: unique original successful receipts validated against current App/render/device transaction; not inferred from canonical state, App frames, poll calls, or scanout
